passes.findings_summary: 4M + 3L. P1-001 (MEDIUM): gate-prompt canon — confirmation gate prompt wording diverged from BC-3.9.014 canonical form; test had been pinned to the wrong prompt string. P1-002 (MEDIUM): not-a-regular-file branch — is_file() pre-flight check (BC-3.9.001 FILE-not-found) did not distinguish between a missing file and a non-regular-file input (a directory passed as FILE); branch was unexercised and code behavior was undefined. P1-003 (MEDIUM): tautological CWE-93 test — test_sec_576_004_content_disposition_crlf_injection_guard asserted percent-encoding presence in a way that would pass even if raw CRLF passed through; the assertion was not strong enough to demonstrate the invariant. P1-004 (MEDIUM): doc 401-exit discrepancy — inline rustdoc on a handler function described exit-code behavior inconsistent with BC-3.9.012 taxonomy (written as exit 1, spec requires exit 2 for 401). 3L: stale comments, story count nits.
passes.fix_round: fix-round-1: gate-prompt string corrected to BC-3.9.014 canonical form (P1-001); is_file() branch added with distinct 'not a regular file' error path and canonical message (P1-002); CWE-93 test assertion hardened to require percent-encoding and explicitly forbid raw CRLF (P1-003); rustdoc corrected to exit 2 taxonomy alignment (P1-004); 3L nits resolved.

passes.findings_summary: 1H + 2M. P2-003 (HIGH — real destructive-path bug): DELETE-404 abort-instead-of-benign-skip. When --replace-existing step 1 found a match and issued DELETE but received 404 (attachment deleted between list-step and delete-step), the handler aborted the entire upload with an error. BC-3.9.017 specifies 404 on the delete step is BENIGN and must be treated as a skip (the attachment is already gone; proceed with POST). This was a correctness bug: a 404 race window caused the upload to fail instead of proceeding. P2-001 (MEDIUM): quote-vector coverage gap — double-quote ('"') in a filename was not covered by the CWE-93/RFC-7230 injection tests; reqwest percent-encodes it but no regression pin existed. P2-002 (MEDIUM): story allow_hyphen_values at 3 live sites — story AC-001, Task 5, and File Structure rows described `allow_hyphen_values = true` on the `<FILE...>` positional, but the shipped code (correctly) omits it; on a multi-value positional allow_hyphen_values causes clap to consume subsequent flags (e.g. --output json) as file path arguments.
passes.fix_round: fix-round-2: DELETE-404 treated as benign skip in --replace-existing flow, not abort (P2-003); regression pin test added (test_bc_3_9_017_delete_404_is_benign_skip); double-quote vector test added (#[cfg(unix)], test_ac_018_double_quote_filename_well_formed_content_disposition) for CWE-93 coverage (P2-001); story corrected at 3 sites to document allow_hyphen_values intentionally ABSENT on multi-value positional with rationale (P2-002). Count 20→22. Story v1.43/v1.44.
